scripts.lint:all: tsc --noEmit --project app/tsconfig.json && npm run lint && abaplint abaplint-cloud.json && abaplint abaplint-downport.json
scripts.build:ui: tsc --noEmit --project app/tsconfig.json && npx ui5 build --clean-dest --dest dist --config app/ui5.yaml
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ui && npm run build:abap && npm run lint:all
scripts.test: npm run clean && abap_transpile abaplint-transpiler.json && node --expose-gc output/index.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run lint:all && npm run test
